description: Create the comprehensive DAaaS platform plan document (PLAN.md) covering all architectural decisions, features, modules, database schema, API design, deployment strategy, AI integration, and development roadmap.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/tts123/daaas-platform/PLAN.md with the following major sections:
1. Executive Summary & Product Vision - mission, problem statement, solution overview, target audience (SMBs without data science teams)
2. Core Features & Modules - data upload/ingestion, data cleaning/preprocessing, data visualization, statistical analysis, ML model generation, AI-powered report generation, collaboration features

3. AI Integration Architecture - single AI gateway design, multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama), model switching, streaming responses, multi-provider fallback chain, prompt management, token tracking

4. Technology Stack Decisions - Django + DRF backend, React + TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL + MongoDB databases, Redis + Celery for async, Docker + Kubernetes deployment, S3 storage, WebSockets for real-time
5. Database Schema Design - complete ERD-style schema for users, organizations, datasets, analyses, ML models, reports, billing, audit logs with all relationships and field types
6. API Design - RESTful API structure with all endpoint groups, request/response formats, pagination, versioning, rate limiting, WebSocket events
7. Frontend Architecture - React app structure, state management, component hierarchy, routing, real-time updates, chart/visualization libraries
8. Authentication & Multi-tenancy - JWT + OAuth2, organization-based tenancy, RBAC (roles: owner, admin, analyst, viewer), API key management
9. Billing & Subscription Model - tiered plans (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise), usage-based pricing for compute/storage/AI tokens, Stripe integration, metering
10. Deployment & Infrastructure - Docker Compose for dev, Kubernetes for production, CI/CD pipeline, monitoring, logging, auto-scaling, blue-green deployments
11. Security Considerations - data encryption (at rest + in transit), input validation, OWASP top 10, data isolation between tenants, GDPR compliance, audit logging, secrets management
12. Development Phases/Roadmap - Phase 1 (MVP), Phase 2 (Advanced Analytics), Phase 3 (ML Platform), Phase 4 (Enterprise), with timelines and deliverables
13. File/Folder Structure - detailed tree of the entire codebase organization
acceptance_criteria: Document is at least 800 lines covering all 13 sections in detail
Database schema includes actual table definitions with columns, types, and relationships
API design includes specific endpoints with HTTP methods and URL patterns
AI gateway architecture describes the provider abstraction, fallback logic, and streaming
Billing section includes specific tier definitions with feature limits
Roadmap includes at least 4 phases with specific deliverables
verification: Verify document length: wc -l /projects/sandbox/tts123/daaas-platform/PLAN.md (should be 800+ lines)
findings: Document created at 3524 lines covering all 13 required sections. Shell escaping issues with backticks in section 3 required post-write fixups using str_replace. Python script files were used to avoid heredoc issues with complex markdown containing code blocks.
